title: Mixed-integer programming formulations for optimal reconfiguration of supply chains
summary: Supply chains are interconnected networks of processes and operations producing and delivering high-value products. These chains are increasingly subjected to structural changes from the energy transition and other external factors. To address this, this work develops mixed-integer programming formulations to identify optimal reconfigurations that preserve industrial operations and profitability.
